name: High Inquisitor Whitemane
summary: At the Scarlet Monastery, High Inquisitor Whitemane directs the Crusade from its Cathedral. A priestess of the Holy Light, she drives the order’s zeal with a consuming hatred of the undead. Alongside Scarlet Commander Renault Mograine, she leads its military and ideological campaigns across Lordaeron.

sections.title: High Inquisitor of the Crusade
sections.body: Whitemane rose swiftly through the Scarlet Crusade. Now she commands the grand Cathedral of the Scarlet Monastery as its High Inquisitor. Her mastery of Holy magic is feared, and her unshakable conviction makes her one of the Crusade’s foremost symbols. She brings the Light against all she deems unclean without mercy.

sections.title: Targets in the Cathedral
sections.body:
After the Third War, Whitemane’s fanaticism has made enemies on both sides. In Southshore, Raleigh the Devout believes the Crusade has fallen into corruption and madness. He calls for Whitemane and Mograine to be eliminated so the order may return to its founding virtues.

In the Undercity, dreadlord Varimathras directs attacks on the Monastery. He means to crush the zealots working on the Forsaken’s doorstep.

faq.answer: Whitemane leads the Scarlet Crusade as its High Inquisitor. From the Cathedral inside the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades, she commands the order’s spiritual and inquisitorial efforts alongside Commander Renault Mograine.

faq.q: Why does Whitemane hate the undead so much?
faq.answer: Whitemane’s hatred follows the Scarlet Crusade’s creed. The order rose from survivors of Lordaeron’s fall to the plague of undeath, and calls every undead an abomination to be purged, whether mindless or free-willed. Whitemane wields the Holy Light relentlessly in that war.

faq.q: Why does the Alliance want Whitemane dead?
aliases: in the name of the light quest
faq.answer: Raleigh the Devout, a former Crusader in Southshore, believes the Scarlet Crusade has sunk into paranoia and madness. He asks Alliance champions to eliminate Whitemane and Mograine, hoping the order can return to its honorable origins.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want Whitemane dead?
faq.answer: Varimathras and the Forsaken in the Undercity see the Scarlet Crusade as a hostile force at their capital’s doorstep. The dreadlord orders Whitemane’s death to break the Monastery’s leadership and remove an immediate threat to the Forsaken realm.

faq.q: What is Whitemane's relationship with Renault Mograine?
faq.answer: Whitemane and Renault Mograine lead the Scarlet Monastery together. They fight side by side in the Cathedral, bound by an intimate bond and mutual devotion to the Crusade’s war against undeath.

angles.text: For a priest, Whitemane shows the terrible power of the Holy Light joined to unbending zeal. Her example warns how conviction can harden into fanatical ruthlessness.
To paladins of the Silver Hand, Whitemane’s leadership shows how Lordaeron’s defenders were corrupted. They abandoned mercy and justice for indiscriminate purges.
To the Forsaken, Whitemane embodies the Crusade’s refusal to distinguish mindless Scourge from free-willed undead. Her destruction is essential to the Undercity’s survival.
Whitemane was once an Alliance citizen of Lordaeron. Her Crusade now attacks outsiders who approach its lands, forcing Southshore’s loyalists to face what their former kin have become.
